34511-the-supposed-autographa-of-john-th.creator: Unknown
34511-the-supposed-autographa-of-john-th.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. manuscripts of John the Scot in Paris, in Reims, in Laon, and in Bamberg, and became convinced, most reluctantly, that his autograph is yet to be found. I here present the chain of facts that make this conclusion inevitable.[3]

arxiv-1908-05354.title: Large-Scale-Exploit of GitHub Repository Metadata and Preventive Measures
arxiv-1908-05354.creator: David Knothe, Frederick Pietschmann
arxiv-1908-05354.description: Abstract Abstract When working with Git, a popular version-control system, email addresses are part of the metadata for each individual commit. When those commits are pushed to remotes, those email addresses become visible not only to fellow developers, but also to malicious actors aiming to exploit them. Remote Git repositories are often hosted by companies specialized in doing so.

arxiv-2102-04462.title: Learning-augmented count-min sketches via Bayesian nonparametrics
arxiv-2102-04462.creator: Emanuele Dolera, Stefano Favaro, Stefano Peluchetti
arxiv-2102-04462.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Emanuele Dolera, Stefano Favaro, Stefano Peluchetti. The count-min sketch (CMS) is a time and memory efficient randomized data structure that provides estimates of tokens’ frequencies in a data stream of tokens, i.e. point queries, based on random hashed data.

arxiv-2103-15843.title: Tilting Planets during Planet Scattering
arxiv-2103-15843.creator: Gongjie Li
arxiv-2103-15843.description: Abstract Observational constraints on planet spin-axis has recently become possible, and revealed a system that favors a large spin-axis misalignment, a low stellar spin-orbit misalignment and a high eccentricity. To explain the origin of such systems, we propose a mechanism that could tilt the planet spin-axis during planet-planet scattering, which are natural outcomes of in-situ formation and disk migration.

arxiv-2109-06535.title: Principal angles between random subspaces and polynomials in two free projections
arxiv-2109-06535.creator: Guillaume Aubrun
arxiv-2109-06535.description: Abstract . We use the geometric concept of principal angles between subspaces to compute the noncommutative distribution of an expression involving two free projections. For example, this allows to simplify a formula by Fevrier–Mastnak–Nica–Szpojankowski about the free Bernoulli anticommutator. We also derive economically an explicit formula for the free additive convolution of Bernoulli distributions.

arxiv-2203-13037.title: Revealing the late-time transition of H 0 H_{0} : relieve the Hubble crisis 2022 Revealing the late-time transition of H 0 H_{0} : relieve the Hubble crisis – References
arxiv-2203-13037.creator: J. P. Hu, F. Y. Wang
arxiv-2203-13037.description: Abstract The discrepancy between the value of the Hubble constant H 0 H_{0} measured from the local distance ladder and from the cosmic microwave background is the most serious challenge to the standard Λ \Lambda CDM model. Various models have been proposed to solve or relieve it, but no satisfactory solution has been given until now.

arxiv-2209-00628.title: Monotonic Gaussian process for physics-constrained machine learning with materials science applications
arxiv-2209-00628.creator: Anh Tran, Kathryn Maupin, Theron Rodgers Computational Materials & Data Science Sandia National Laboratories Albuquerque, NM 87185 Email: trodger@sandia.gov
arxiv-2209-00628.description: Abstract Physics-constrained machine learning is emerging as an important topic in the field of machine learning for physics. One of the most significant advantages of incorporating physics constraints into machine learning methods is that the resulting model requires significantly less data to train.

arxiv-2304-10517.title: Segment Anything Model for Medical Image Analysis: an Experimental Study
arxiv-2304-10517.creator: Maciej A. Mazurowski, Haoyu Dong, Hanxue Gu, Jichen Yang, Nicholas Konz, Yixin Zhang
arxiv-2304-10517.description: Abstract Training segmentation models for medical images continues to be challenging due to the limited availability of data annotations. Segment Anything Model (SAM) is a foundation model that is intended to segment user-defined objects of interest in an interactive manner. While the performance on natural images is impressive, medical image domains pose their own set of challenges.

arxiv-2307-03222.title: Probing the two-body decaying dark matter scenario with weak lensing and the cosmic microwave background
arxiv-2307-03222.creator: Jozef Bucko, Sambit K. Giri, Fabian Hervas Peters, Aurel Schneider
arxiv-2307-03222.description: Abstract Decaying dark matter (DDM) scenarios have recently regained attention due to their potential ability to resolve the well-known clustering (or S 8 S_{8} ) tension between weak lensing (WL) and cosmic microwave background (CMB) measurements. In this paper, we investigate a well-established model where the original dark matter particle decays into a massless particle and a massive daughter particle.

arxiv-2309-02322.title: Fairness of Exposure in Dynamic Recommendation DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: ACM Conference on Recommender Systems; September 18–22, 2023; Singapore Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2309-02322.creator: Masoud Mansoury, Bamshad Mobasher
arxiv-2309-02322.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Masoud Mansoury, Bamshad Mobasher. Exposure bias is a well-known issue in recommender systems where the exposure is not fairly distributed among items in the recommendation results. This is especially problematic when bias is amplified over time as a few items (e.g., popular ones) are repeatedly over-represented in recommendation lists and users’ interactions with those items will amplify bias towards those items over time resulting in a feedback loop .

arxiv-2402-09569.title: Automated Plaque Detection and Agatston Score Estimation on Non-Contrast CT Scans: A Multicenter Study
arxiv-2402-09569.creator: Andrew M. Nguyen, Jianfei Liu, Tejas Sudharshan Mathai, Peter C. Grayson, Ronald M. Summers
arxiv-2402-09569.description: Abstract Coronary artery calcification (CAC) is a strong and independent predictor of cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, manual assessment of CAC often requires radiological expertise, time, and invasive imaging techniques. The purpose of this multicenter study is to validate an automated cardiac plaque detection model using a 3D multiclass nnU-Net for gated and non-gated non-contrast chest CT volumes.

arxiv-2403-02622.title: World Models for Autonomous Driving: An Initial Survey
arxiv-2403-02622.creator: Yanchen Guan *, Haicheng Liao *, Zhenning Li, Jia Hu, Runze Yuan, Yunjian Li, Guohui Zhang, and Chengzhong Xu
arxiv-2403-02622.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yanchen Guan *, Haicheng Liao *, Zhenning Li, Jia Hu, Runze Yuan, Yunjian Li, Guohui Zhang, and Chengzhong Xu. In the rapidly evolving landscape of autonomous driving, the capability to accurately predict future events and assess their implications is paramount for both safety and efficiency, critically aiding the decision-making process. World models have emerged as a transformative approach, enabling autonomous driving systems to synthesize and interpret vast amounts of sensor data, thereby predicting potential future scenarios and compensating for information gaps.

arxiv-2406-19955.title: The pressureless damped Euler-Riesz system in the critical regularity framework
arxiv-2406-19955.creator: Meiling Chi, Ling-Yun Shou, Jiang Xu
arxiv-2406-19955.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Meiling Chi, Ling-Yun Shou, Jiang Xu. We are concerned with a system governing the evolution of the pressureless compressible Euler equations with Riesz interaction and damping in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} ( d ≥ 1 d\geq 1 ), where the interaction force is given by ∇ ( − Δ ) α − d 2 ​ ( ρ − ρ ¯ ) \nabla(-\Delta)^{\smash{\frac{\alpha-d}{2}}}(\rho-\bar{\rho}) with d − 2 < α < d d-2<\alpha<d .

arxiv-2409-04990.title: Neutral particle collisions near Gibbons-Maeda-Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger black holes after shadow observations
arxiv-2409-04990.creator: Naoki Tsukamoto, Ryotaro Kase
arxiv-2409-04990.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Naoki Tsukamoto, Ryotaro Kase. A Gibbons-Maeda-Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GMGHS) black hole with a magnetic charge (or an electric charge) has noteworthy features that its scalar curvature near the event horizon of the black hole with the almost maximal charge can be extremely large. The large curvature, which is related with the gravity on a finite-sized object or between two points, causes high center-of-mass energy for two neutral particles near the almost maximally charged GMGHS black hole.

arxiv-2411-05899.title: Streaming Bayes GFlowNets
arxiv-2411-05899.creator: Tiago da Silva, Daniel Augusto de Souza, Diego Mesquita
arxiv-2411-05899.description: Abstract Bayes’ rule naturally allows for inference refinement in a streaming fashion, without the need to recompute posteriors from scratch whenever new data arrives. In principle, Bayesian streaming is straightforward: we update our prior with the available data and use the resulting posterior as a prior when processing the next data chunk.

arxiv-2412-06952.title: Massively Parallel Algorithms for Approximate Shortest Paths
arxiv-2412-06952.description: Abstract We present fast algorithms for approximate shortest paths in the massively parallel computation (MPC) model. We provide randomized algorithms that take ⁡ p ​ o ​ l ​ y ​ ( log ⁡ log ⁡ n ) \mathop{\mathrm{}}{poly}(\log{\log{n}}) rounds in the near-linear memory MPC model.

arxiv-2509-24566.title: TokenSwap: Backdoor Attack on the Compositional Understanding of Large Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2509-24566.creator: Zhifang Zhang, Qiqi Tao, Jiaqi Lv, Na Zhao, Lei Feng, Joey Tianyi Zhou
arxiv-2509-24566.description: Abstract Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of vision-language tasks, while they remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing backdoor attacks on LVLMs aim to force the victim model to generate a predefined target pattern, which is either inserted into or replaces the original content.

arxiv-2511-16177.creator: Thomas Collignon, Kouds Halitim, Raphaël Bleuse, Sophie Cerf, Bogdan Robu, Éric Rutten, Lionel Seinturier, Alexandre van Kempen
arxiv-2511-16177.description: Abstract . Efficient data access in High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems is essential to the performance of intensive computing tasks. Traditional optimizations of the I/O stack aim to improve peak performance but are often workload specific and require deep expertise, making them difficult to generalize or re-use.

britannica-1911-catherine-of-valois.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica

pmc-10667727.title: An experimental study of information transparency and social preferences on donation behaviors: the self-signaling model
pmc-10667727.creator: Minnie H. C. She, Alan G. Sanfey
pmc-10667727.description: Certain segments of the population reply on charitable or other non-governmental organizations as their main source of support, with these organizations largely funded by those in society who can afford to give. The present study investigated to what extent information transparency influences donation decisions, and whether specific preferences for charities influences information seeking behavior.

pmc-10688636.title: Research on farmers’ adoption of additional technology combinations: Practice from Chongqing, China
pmc-10688636.creator: Yu Li, Zhiheng Zhang
pmc-10688636.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Tobacco farmers often adopt additional multiple agricultural technologies (AMATs) in addition to implementing the standardized technical system in China. Based on the cross-sectional micro data of 346 households of Chongqing, China, this paper assesses the determinants and impacts of the adoption of AMATs on income by using a multinomial endogenous treatment effects model to correct for selection bias and endogeneity caused by observed and unobserved heterogeneity.

pmc-11356923.title: Tracing Acinetobacter baumannii’s Journey from Hospitals to Aquatic Ecosystems
pmc-11356923.creator: Irina Gheorghe-Barbu, Rares-Ionut Dragomir, Gratiela Gradisteanu Pircalabioru, Marius Surleac, Iulia Adelina Dinu, Madalina Diana Gaboreanu, Ilda Czobor Barbu
pmc-11356923.description: Background: This study provides a comprehensive analysis of Acinetobacter baumannii in aquatic environments and fish microbiota by integrating culture-dependent methods, 16S metagenomics, and antibiotic resistance profiling. Methods: A total of 83 A. baumannii isolates were recovered using culture-dependent methods from intra-hospital infections (IHI) and wastewater (WW) and surface water (SW) samples from two southern Romanian cities in August 2022.

pmc-11437109.title: Effect of sulfur on synergistic corrosion behavior of Q235 and 16Mn steel in sodium aluminate solution
pmc-11437109.creator: Dongyu Li, Bianli Quan, Junqi Li, Chaoyi Chen, Jun Xu, Hanli Wang
pmc-11437109.description: In this study, the corrosion electrochemistry and corrosion behavior of two steels were studied under the simulated alumina production conditions. The corrosion rate of 16Mn steel is greater than that of Q235 steel. The effect of S2− concentration on corrosion rate was significantly higher than that of S2O32−.

pmc-11478049.title: An Overview of Naphthylimide as Specific Scaffold for New Drug Discovery
pmc-11478049.creator: Wei Ruan, Zhouling Xie, Ying Wang, Lulu Xia, Yuping Guo, Dan Qiao
pmc-11478049.description: Naphthylimides play a pivotal role as aromatic heterocyclic compounds, serving as the foundational structures for numerous pharmacologically significant drugs. These drugs encompass antibacterial, antifungal, anticancer, antimalarial, antiviral, anti-inflammatory, antithrombotic, and antiprotozoal agents. The planar and heteroaromatic characteristics of naphthylimides grant them a strong ability to intercalate into DNA. This intercalation property renders naphthylimide derivatives highly valuable for various biological activities.

pmc-12419137.title: CD4 T Cells Acquire Innate Capability Upon Classical T Cell Activation
pmc-12419137.creator: Nima Yassini, Eva Goljat, Camilla Panetti, Matthias Rath, Nicole Joller
pmc-12419137.description: Memory T cells, a sizable compartment of the mature immune system, enable enhanced responses upon re‐infection with the same pathogen. We have recently shown that virus‐experienced innate acting T (TIA) cells can modulate infectious or autoimmune diseases through TCR‐independent IFN‐γ production. However, how these cells arise remains unclear.

pmc-12613300.title: Connecting cultural wisdom, physical literacy, and physical activity among older adults from diverse Indigenous communities: an exploratory review
pmc-12613300.creator: Amanda Froehlich Chow, Heather McWhinney, Tina Alexis, M. Louise Humbert
pmc-12613300.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Indigenous older adults across the globe face higher rates of chronic illness and lower life expectancy than non-Indigenous populations, yet little research has examined how physical literacy might support their health and well-being. Traditionally applied to children and youth, physical literacy—understood as one’s relationship with movement and physical activity across the life course—shares with Indigenous worldviews an emphasis on holistic well-being rooted in culture, community, and the environment.

pmc-12663642.title: Late secondary syphilis mimicking anal carcinoma: A case illustration
pmc-12663642.creator: Aanika Balaji Warner, John Woller, Philip Wagner
pmc-12663642.description: Syphilis can closely mimic malignancy in both clinical presentation and appearance. We describe a case of a 58-year-old man presenting with painful perianal masses raising concern for anal carcinoma. Serologic testing revealed late secondary syphilis with a rapid plasma reagin titer of 1:128. Treatment with doxycycline resulted in complete clinical resolution and appropriate serologic response, obviating planned biopsy.

pmc-12852918.title: Application of kilohertz-frequency block to mitigate off-target motor effects of vagus nerve stimulation in swine
pmc-12852918.creator: Kevin P. Cheng, Ashlesha Deshmukh, Aaron K. Gholston, Megan L. Settell, Bruce E. Knudsen, Maria LaLuzerne, James K. Trevathan, Aaron J. Suminski, Nicole A. Pelot, Warren M. Grill, Kip A. Ludwig
pmc-12852918.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Selective activation of small versus large diameter nerve fibers represents a broad challenge in the electrical modulation of neural activity for clinical applications. For example, off-target activation of motor nerve fibers was implicated in several failed vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) clinical trials by effectively limiting maximum applicable current amplitudes, thereby preventing robust activation of smaller diameter fibers responsible for therapeutic effects.

pmc-13178417.title: Amyloid light-chain amyloidosis with cardiac failure: a case description and literature analysis
pmc-13178417.creator: Lei Liu, Yiting Lyu, Shenggang Zhao
pmc-13178417.description: 1). Clinical manifestations of AL amyloidosis vary according to the organs involved. Cardiac amyloidosis may be life-threatening, and early detection can increase the likelihood of survival (2). The main risk factor for AL amyloidosis is the presence of a plasma cell dyscrasia, such as monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance or multiple myeloma (3).

pmc-13592062.title: Chromodomain Helicase DNA–Binding Proteins and Spermatogenesis: Current Advances
pmc-13592062.creator: Mingrui Zhang, Di Liu, Guoqiang Liu, Minggang Zhu, Feng Pan
pmc-13592062.description: BackgroundMale infertility is a prevalent clinical condition, with approximately one‐third of cases classified as idiopathic, frequently stemming from impaired spermatogenesis because of dysregulated gene expression. Chromodomain helicase DNA‐binding (CHD) proteins are central chromatin remodelers that orchestrate this epigenetic regulation. For instance, smoking‐induced hypermethylation of the CHD5 gene promoter is associated with impaired semen parameters.
